title: More Than Sunday Worship
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores the often-overlooked ministry of helps and reveals why it's a crucial part of the Christian life. Discover how serving others with humility and compassion is not just a duty, but a vital way to build up the body of Christ and advance God's kingdom. In this sermon, learn how you can get involved in serving others and experience the transformative power of living out your faith in practical ways.
